// A fixture standing in for `apps/host-opencode/src/probe.ts`: one runtime
// reaching sideways into a sibling runtime's src/ by relative path. No manifest
// records this edge, which is exactly why a manifest audit cannot see it.

import { openDaemonSocket } from "@reddb-io/redskilled";
import { graphRecall } from "../../plugin-memory/src/graph-recall.js";

export const probe = async (): Promise<unknown> => {
  const socket = await openDaemonSocket();
  return graphRecall(socket);
};
